children: Ahead of next week's meetings with China, the USDA has announced a new flash sale of U.S. soybeans to the world's biggest agricultural buyer. The USDA says that 111,000 metric tons of soybeans have been sold to China for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year. It's the first flash sale to China since Sept. 10. Next week's meetings are expected to have a lot of importance for U.S. agricultural trade. "China's recent US soybean buying has increased the agricultural importance of the meeting," says Joe Davis of Futures International in a note. "State-owned food trader Cofco is expected to be represented in the broader Chinese delegation, keeping attention on possible additional purchases of US agricultural products." (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
